check_recovery.note: A task is repaired when its file's error count returns to the baseline measured on the clean tree immediately before the defect was applied — not to zero, since some files carry a pre-existing error (t09 is a verified 1->5). Each defect raises the count by a verified amount, between 1 and 5. Scored by re-running the reference checker here, never by reading the run's own verdict.

wall_clock_s.note: This rig re-prefills the whole transcript each turn, so per-turn cost grows with the transcript. That is a property of the probe server, not of TRELLIS.

floor_note: A floor is a configuration — model, quantization, runtime — not a parameter count. Outcomes are tallied separately because they fail for different reasons; a run with no valid tool call yields 0/0 on check-recovery, not 0%.
